Do not claim that every violence indicator is rising. Some indicators declined or stayed stable from 2016 to 2021-22.
The stronger product story is not 'everything is increasing'; it is that first-step help remains complex, state-specific, and hard to navigate.
COVID-19 context and ABS comparability cautions should be kept visible when using time trends.
